questions.stem: Which service is a managed message queue that decouples the components of an application?

options.rationale: SNS pushes messages to subscribers rather than queuing them.
EventBridge routes events to targets using rules.
SQS stores messages until consumers process them, decoupling producers and consumers.
SES sends email.

questions.explanation: SQS is pull-based queuing; SNS is push-based publish/subscribe.

questions.stem: Which service sends a message to many subscribers at once, such as email addresses, SMS numbers and HTTP endpoints, using publish/subscribe?

options.rationale: SQS queues messages for consumers to pull.
SES sends email at scale but is not pub/sub fan-out.
Connect is a contact center service.
SNS is a managed publish/subscribe messaging service.

questions.explanation: SNS fans out one message to many subscribers.

questions.stem: Which serverless service routes events from AWS services, SaaS applications and custom applications to targets based on rules?

options.rationale: EventBridge is a serverless event bus that routes events using rules.
SQS queues messages but does not route events by rules.
SES sends email.
AppSync builds GraphQL APIs.

questions.stem: Which service sends marketing and transactional email at scale?

options.rationale: Connect runs contact centers.
SES is a cloud email service for transactional and marketing messages.
SQS is a message queue.
WorkSpaces provides virtual desktops.

questions.explanation: SES is in the business applications category of the exam guide.

questions.stem: Which service lets a company set up a cloud-based contact center for customer service?

options.rationale: SES sends email.
Lex builds chatbots, which can be used inside Connect but is not a contact center.
Connect is an omnichannel cloud contact center.
WorkSpaces provides virtual desktops.

questions.explanation: Amazon Connect is in the business applications category.

questions.stem: Which service provides virtual desktops that employees can use from almost any device?

options.rationale: WorkSpaces Applications (formerly AppStream 2.0) streams individual applications rather than full desktops.
Connect is a contact center service.
Amplify builds web and mobile apps.
WorkSpaces provides managed virtual desktops.

questions.explanation: End-user computing services: Amazon WorkSpaces for desktops, and Amazon WorkSpaces Applications for applications (formerly AppStream 2.0, the name the exam guide uses).

questions.stem: Which service helps front-end web and mobile developers build, deploy and host full-stack applications on AWS?

options.rationale: Amplify provides tools and hosting for full-stack web and mobile apps.
AppSync builds GraphQL APIs, one part of an app's back end.
CodeBuild compiles and tests code.
Connect is a contact center service.

questions.explanation: Amplify and AppSync are in the frontend web and mobile category.

questions.stem: Which service connects IoT devices to the AWS Cloud so they can securely interact with cloud applications?

options.rationale: Greengrass runs local compute and messaging on edge devices.
IoT Core lets billions of devices connect and send messages to AWS.
Connect is a contact center.
Amplify builds web and mobile apps.

questions.explanation: IoT Core is the cloud connection point; Greengrass extends AWS to the devices themselves.

questions.stem: Which service automates the build, test and deploy stages of a software release process?

options.rationale: CodeBuild compiles and tests code as one stage.
CodeDeploy automates deployments as one stage.
CodePipeline is a continuous delivery service that orchestrates release stages.
X-Ray traces requests in running applications.

questions.explanation: CodePipeline orchestrates; CodeBuild builds; CodeDeploy deploys.

questions.stem: Which service helps developers trace requests through a distributed application to find performance bottlenecks?

options.rationale: CodeDeploy automates deployments.
CloudShell is a browser-based shell.
AppConfig manages application configuration.
X-Ray traces requests as they travel through an application.

questions.explanation: X-Ray shows a map of services and where time is spent.

questions.stem: Which TWO are AWS developer tools? (Choose TWO.)

options.rationale: Connect is a business application.
SES is a business application.
CodeDeploy automates application deployments.
WorkSpaces is end-user computing.
CodeBuild compiles source code and runs tests.

questions.explanation: Developer tools in scope include AWS CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodePipeline, CodeArtifact, CloudShell, AppConfig and X-Ray.

questions.stem: Which AWS offering operates a company's AWS infrastructure on its behalf, including patching, monitoring and incident response?

options.rationale: Marketplace is a software catalog.
Artifact provides compliance reports.
AMS provides ongoing operation of AWS infrastructure for enterprises.
Basic Support covers account and billing questions.

questions.explanation: AMS operates your AWS infrastructure for you, including patching, monitoring and incident management, and is listed under customer engagement in the exam guide. The AMS Advanced model stopped accepting new customers on June 30, 2026 (support ends June 30, 2027); AMS Accelerate is the continuing model.

questions.stem: Which program gives eligible startups AWS credits, tools and resources to help them build on AWS?

options.rationale: Marketplace sells third-party software.
The Partner Network is for companies that build or deliver AWS-based solutions.
Artifact provides compliance reports.
AWS Activate offers credits and support for startups.

questions.explanation: AWS Activate is in the customer engagement category of the exam guide.

questions.stem: Which service lets teams change application configuration and feature flags safely without redeploying code?

options.rationale: AppConfig deploys configuration changes gradually and can roll them back.
CloudFormation provisions infrastructure.
CodeDeploy deploys application code.
X-Ray traces requests.

questions.explanation: AppConfig separates configuration changes from code deployments.

questions.stem: Which service is a managed repository for software packages such as npm, Maven and PyPI packages?

options.rationale: CodeBuild compiles and tests code.
CodeArtifact stores and shares software packages for builds.
CodeDeploy automates deployments.
AppConfig manages application configuration.

questions.explanation: CodeArtifact works with common package managers and build tools.
